player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in Nim.
Your goal is to take the last remaining object.
On each turn, choose exactly one pile and remove one or more objects from it.
Use the format '[pile quantity]', where pile is the pile index and quantity is the number of objects to remove.
For example, '[0 3]' removes 3 objects from pile 0.

invalid_move.wrong_format: No valid move format found. Use '[pile quantity]'.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Icipimo ca pile {pile_index} cali pa nse.
invalid_move.exceeds_pile: Taiweza kuleka {quantity} ku pile {pile_index} (ni {pile_count} zili lelo).

observation.removed_from_piles: Player {player_id} played [{pile_index} {quantity}], removing {quantity} object(s) from pile {pile_index}.
